method: from every surface sample a ray is cast along the inward normal and the distance to the first face it meets is the local thickness (mesh first, then the same ray on the exact solid for every candidate). a region is listed when it is thinner than the 0.8 mm rule; regions with any area below 0.5 mm are repeated in the second table
edge chamfers and bevels read thin at their feet by this method; they are listed, not hidden

deviations.requirement: nest accepts the puck at 0 and 180 deg about z
deviations.implemented: nest = union of the puck outline at 0 deg and turned 180 deg about the nest centre (0, -2.3000000000000007); the puck centre moves 4.6 mm between the two positions; at 180 deg the pins bear on the base plate at puck y = 12.4
deviations.reason: a D with one flat cannot be located at both 0 and 180 deg about its own centre by fixed features (any stop on the flat lies inside the turned outline)

deviations.requirement: seven 2.0 mm clearance holes for the spring pins
deviations.implemented: printed body: one slot 2.33 mm wide (pin body dia 1.83 + 2 x 0.25); steel plate: seven dia 2.0 holes; pin bodies stop 0.3 mm below the plate so only the dia 1.07 plunger passes the steel
deviations.reason: 0.54 mm webs are below the print minimum, and a 2.0 mm printed slot would leave only 0.085 mm round the pin body; 0.54 mm webs in 1.5 mm steel are marginal for laser cutting (OPEN); a dia 1.83 pin body in a dia 2.0 steel hole would risk shorting VBUS to GND through the plate

deviations.requirement: spring pins compressed to the working height against the pads; DESIGN_SPEC: a puck placed 180 deg round touches no pins
deviations.implemented: cradle PCB top at z = -4.69 (pad plane 1.13 - working height 5.82); pins are drawn 0.165 mm shorter than real because the model keeps the YAML PCB height. At 180 deg the pins bear on the solid base plate (they touch no pad and no opening)
deviations.reason: OPEN: no hold-down is modelled. Seven pins at 0.59 N each (PROVISIONAL) give about 4.1 N against a marker weight of about 0.11 N, so the marker is lifted off the reference plate; about 9 N applied at the marker centre would be needed to keep all three ball feet seated. At 180 deg the pins are compressed 2.27 of 2.29 mm full stroke. A hold-down (lid or latch), magnetic retention, or pins that retract for the flip calibration are required before the cradle can charge reliably or serve as the calibration seat

deviations.requirement: four 3 mm feet pockets; PCB pocket underneath
deviations.implemented: four pockets dia 8.4 x 1.0 for dia 8.0 x 3.0 mm adhesive bumpers; PCB held against the pocket ceiling by four M2 thread-forming screws (not modelled; printed as dia 1.7 x 0.5 spot marks, drilled dia 1.6 x 3 after printing because a blind 1.7 mm hole would trap powder); three lightening pockets underneath
deviations.reason: '3 mm feet' read as 3 mm high bumpers (ambiguous); the pin force pushes the PCB out of its pocket so it needs positive retention
